heading: Acceptance of voluntary services and money or property
lead: The President’s Committee on Employment of People With Disabilities—

tree.text: notwithstanding section 1342 of title 31, may accept voluntary and uncompensated services; and
may solicit, accept, use, and dispose of any money or property the Committee receives.
